scope: Proposition 5.6 (Subexponential smooth bounds) of the manuscript “Quantitative Near-Kerr Evolution and Generic C2 Future Inextendibility” (preprints/Quantitative-Near-Kerr-Evolution-and-Generic-C2-Future-Inextendibility-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cd38cc55e3c203a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the global base bounds resulting from the compact-far closure. For every fixed C0 > 0, every fixed smooth order, and every σ > 0, all metric, coefficient and parameter norms at that order on 0 ≤ t ≤ T′ , ry ≤ C0(1 + T′ ) are bounded by CσeσT′ . The constant may depend on the smooth datum, the order and C0, but the base neighborhood and fixed filter do not. We denote these bounds by eo(T′).
